how: Sample 5 to 10 completions at temperature above zero, extract each final answer, and vote. Ties or wide scatter are themselves a signal the problem needs a different approach.
name: Self-Consistency
what: Running the same reasoning prompt several times with sampling enabled and taking the majority answer across the runs.
paper: Wang et al., Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models (2022)
when_fails: Open-ended tasks with no single right answer, and anywhere latency or cost matters: ten runs cost ten times the tokens for a few points of accuracy.
when_works: Problems with one verifiable answer, math, dates, counts, where independent reasoning paths tend to converge on the truth and errors scatter.
